grammar.title: have a + 名词 = 对应的动词

parts.text: have 词本意“有，拥有”：I have a book. have a + 双词性(动词与名词) = 对应的动词 “have + 名词”代替普通动词表示“完成该动作”

headers: 助动词（无实义，用于完成时态中）
rows: have a + 修饰 + 双词性(动词与名词)：have a long walk
一个动词的后面会加介词(如果这个动词是不及物动词)，动词能加什么样的介词，名词也可以加什么样的介词
look at → have a look at
walk across → have a walk across
succeed in doing sth. → be successful in → success in

parts.text: 类似的动词有 dance，fight，ride， talk，sleep，wash等。
I had two dances with Lucy. 可以使用two修饰动词的次数
Jim and I have just had a long talk. 可使用形容词修饰动作

rows: I wanted to have a smoke. 原型
I swam in the sea this morning.
I had a swim in the sea this morning. 一般过去
She is having a rest. 现在进行
Did you have a sleep last night?
Did you sleep well last night? 副词修饰动词
Did you have a good sleep last night? 形容词修饰名词
